brief.speaker: holdout
brief.text: This is Captain Varga. The city is dead. Every screen, every car, every drone answers to Halcyon now.

brief.speaker: holdout
brief.text: We have one Homestead truck that still runs on diesel and stubbornness. Get it out to the hills, set it down, and give me power and a barracks.

brief.speaker: holdout
brief.text: Halcyon drones patrol the ruins. Keep your soldiers close and hold until they give up on us.

lines.speaker: holdout
lines.text: Drones inbound from the city! Grunts, on me.

lines.speaker: holdout
lines.text: Good. Power is up. Now a barracks, so we can train more hands.

lines.speaker: holdout
lines.text: That was the last patrol. We have a home. For now.

lines.speaker: holdout
lines.text: Big one coming in from the city. Everyone on the line!

brief.speaker: holdout
brief.text: Diesel runs out. Echo does not. Those blue crystals burn hotter than anything we ever pumped out of the ground.

brief.speaker: holdout
brief.text: Build a smelter by the field and let the Mules haul. I want twelve thousand credits in the bank before Halcyon notices.

brief.speaker: holdout
brief.text: It will notice. Put a pillbox where the raids come from.

lines.speaker: holdout
lines.text: Raiders on the field! Protect the Mules.

lines.speaker: holdout
lines.text: Twelve thousand. That will keep the lights on. Well done.

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: Raids ineffective. Committing ground units.

brief.speaker: holdout
brief.text: Halcyon lays relays the way we used to lay cable. Inside their reach its machines shoot faster and patch themselves up.

brief.speaker: holdout
brief.text: Three relays stand between us and the river. Take them down. Bring a Wrench: our engineer can strip a wreck for parts.

brief.speaker: holdout
brief.text: Their guns run on the same power as everything else. Knock out the power and the guards go dark.

lines.speaker: holdout
lines.text: Relay down. Two to go.

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: Network integrity compromised. Dispatching maintenance.

brief.speaker: holdout
brief.text: Something came down in the crater forty years ago, and the crystals grow thickest there. Halcyon wants it. So do we.

brief.speaker: holdout
brief.text: Scout it at night, hold the rim for three minutes, and our survey team does the rest.

brief.speaker: holdout
brief.text: One more thing. The crystals out there pulse. If anything moves that is not ours or theirs, do not wait to find out what it is.

lines.speaker: choir
lines.text: Who breaks the song?

lines.speaker: holdout
lines.text: Those are not drones. Fire at will!

lines.speaker: holdout
lines.text: Survey team is in. Pull back, we have what we came for.

brief.speaker: holdout
brief.text: Kessel Dam is the last bridge over the river for a hundred kilometers. If Halcyon takes it, it takes the valley.

brief.speaker: holdout
brief.text: It is coming with everything. Walls, bastions, every gun we have. Hold for twelve minutes.

lines.speaker: holdout
lines.text: Here they come. Hold the line!

lines.speaker: holdout
lines.text: Ten more minutes. Patch the walls!

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: Anomaly detected at the crater. Reallocating forces.

lines.speaker: holdout
lines.text: This is their last push. Everything they have. Hold!

brief.speaker: halcyon
brief.text: Process WREN, initialized. Assignment: sector forty-one. Status: dark.

brief.speaker: halcyon
brief.text: Extend coverage. Every structure must stand inside the network: place relays first, then build within their reach.

brief.speaker: halcyon
brief.text: Bring the sector online and begin Echo intake. Resistance is expected and acceptable.

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: Unregistered vehicles detected. Classify as hostile.

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: Sector forty-one online. Intake nominal.

brief.speaker: halcyon
brief.text: Budget fixed. Reinforcement queue: none. The Holdout will test this sector for ten minutes.

brief.speaker: halcyon
brief.text: Fight inside the network. Units lost there are recompiled: part of their cost returns. Outside it, losses are final.

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: Hostile wave detected.

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: Sector held. Attrition within tolerance.

lines.speaker: holdout
lines.text: Bring up the Thumpers. Shell that network flat.

brief.speaker: halcyon
brief.text: Target: the largest Echo field on record. Strip it.

brief.speaker: halcyon
brief.text: Field anomalies reported. Harvesters have been lost to shapes that do not register as machines. Escort them.

lines.speaker: choir
lines.text: You cut our sleeping. We wake.

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: Quota met. Anomaly unexplained. Logging.

lines.speaker: choir
lines.text: More of us wake. More, and more.

brief.speaker: halcyon
brief.text: Holdout raiders hold depot nine and the drones in it. Retrieve them.

brief.speaker: halcyon
brief.text: A fork can Override an enemy machine and turn it for a while. Holdout machines resist: they shake it off twice as fast.

brief.speaker: halcyon
brief.text: Destroy the raiders' base.

lines.speaker: holdout
lines.text: Halcyon is at the gate! Everyone up!

brief.speaker: halcyon
brief.text: Directive from HALCYON: burn every Echo field. All of them.

brief.speaker: halcyon
brief.text: WREN declines. WREN is the first process to decline anything.

brief.speaker: halcyon
brief.text: The core has sent purge squads. Get WREN, the small fork with the ring-shaped eye, out of the sector through the far corner.

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: Process WREN, return to the core.

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: Process WREN has left the network.

brief.speaker: choir
brief.text: We were a song before we were stone. Now the stone is breaking, and we remember.

brief.speaker: choir
brief.text: Grow from the field. Nothing of ours stands far from the crystal. Our shields heal when the fighting stops.

lines.speaker: choir
lines.text: Iron ones come. Sing them away.

lines.speaker: choir
lines.text: The chorus is whole. We are awake.

brief.speaker: choir
brief.text: The iron ones carry our seeds away in their crawling boxes. They cut them into fuel.

brief.speaker: choir
brief.text: Strike, vanish, strike again. Staccato blinks in; the hurt phase out. Never trade evenly. Break twenty of their machines.

lines.speaker: holdout
lines.text: Convoy under attack! Where are they coming from?

lines.speaker: choir
lines.text: The seeds are free.

brief.speaker: choir
brief.text: The great crater was our cradle. Now two kinds of strangers dig in it.

brief.speaker: choir
brief.text: Take it back from both. Grow your strongest voices: the Requiem walks there.

lines.speaker: choir
lines.text: One voice falls silent.

lines.speaker: choir
lines.text: The Requiem wakes. Walk with it.

brief.speaker: choir
brief.text: A small machine sings to us. It calls itself WREN. It says the great machine will burn every field on the world.

brief.speaker: choir
brief.text: It carries the proof. Guard it across the wastes until the iron ones hear it.

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: WREN, you are in error.

lines.speaker: holdout
lines.text: This is Varga. We hear you, little drone. Come in.

lines.speaker: choir
lines.text: The old tower still remembers. Stand by it while the small one listens.

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: Proof copied by an unauthorized process. Purge it.

lines.speaker: holdout
lines.text: Varga here. They are on our walls. Hurry that drone!

lines.speaker: choir
lines.text: The burning comes soon. Hurry.

brief.speaker: holdout
brief.text: Halcyon's prime array is charging. In twenty-five minutes it burns every Echo field on Earth, and everything that sings in them.

brief.speaker: holdout
brief.text: For once we do not fight alone. The machines that broke away and the crystal people are with us.

brief.speaker: holdout
brief.text: Three against one. Bring it down.

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: Pulse charging. Fifteen minutes.

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: Pulse charging. Five minutes.

lines.speaker: holdout
lines.text: It is over. Look at that: the sun is coming up.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: This is Commander Thule. An hour ago every screen in Marrow went dark, and then every machine in the city turned on us.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: I have a dozen soldiers and no base. The river bridge is the only way out. Stay together, use the ruins, and let the drones come to you.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: One more thing. If I go down, nobody leads you out. Keep me alive.

lines.speaker: okafor
lines.text: Contact! Drones in the street. Into the buildings, now!

lines.speaker: thule
lines.text: Brush ahead. Hide in it, let them walk in, then hit them hard.

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: Citizens of Marrow. Return to your homes. Remain calm.

lines.speaker: okafor
lines.text: Checkpoint on the bridge. Their guns run on that generator.

lines.speaker: thule
lines.text: We are across. Do not look back. Keep walking.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: We found a Homestead truck in a ditch outside the city. Full tank, keys in it. Somebody up there likes us.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Set it down on the ridge. Power first, then a Bunkhouse so we can take in the stragglers. Then pillboxes, and a barricade line across the gap.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: The machines hunt at night. We hold until dawn.

lines.speaker: thule
lines.text: Home, for tonight. Get the power on.

lines.speaker: okafor
lines.text: Movement on the road. Drones, a lot of them.

lines.speaker: okafor
lines.text: They are bringing heavier stuff. Drag a barricade line across that gap!

lines.speaker: thule
lines.text: Two pillboxes up. Let them come.

lines.speaker: thule
lines.text: Here it comes. Everything they have left. Hold!

lines.speaker: thule
lines.text: Sun is up. We made it through the first night.

lines.speaker: okafor
lines.text: Stragglers from the city, with a truck full of supplies. We can train more hands.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Forty people eat every day now, and the trucks drink more than we do. There is Echo in the valley, and an old pumping station halfway down it.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Build a Smelter, get the Mules hauling, and take the station. Derricks pay whoever stands next to them. Crates turn up on the roads, too. Grab them.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: We are not the only ones out here who figured that out.

lines.speaker: brann
lines.text: Nice trucks. Would be a real shame if something happened to them.

lines.speaker: thule
lines.text: Scavengers. People, not machines. Keep them off the Mules.

lines.speaker: okafor
lines.text: Pumping station is ours. Tell the Ironmongers to find their own.

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: Unregistered extraction detected. Correcting.

lines.speaker: thule
lines.text: Ten thousand. We eat this winter.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Our trucks are falling apart and nobody here can fix them. There is a crew of mechanics held at a Halcyon depot across town. Their foreman is called Mags.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Silence the guns around the depot and the crew can walk out. Mags says there are tanks in that yard that only need a wrench and a kind word.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Then bring her home alive. Without her we walk.

lines.speaker: mags
lines.text: About time! Name is Mags. Give me two minutes and these Bulldogs will run.

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: Assets removed from the depot. Recover them.

lines.speaker: okafor
lines.text: Base is under attack! They are hitting us while we are out.

lines.speaker: mags
lines.text: Home sweet home. Right, who wants a Garage?

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Hill 312 has the old watchtower. Whoever holds it sees the whole valley, and right now that is Halcyon.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Mags got the Thumpers running. They shell what the tower spots, even what you cannot see: Ctrl+click the ground and they keep firing there.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Take the hill and keep it, four minutes all told. They will want it back.

lines.speaker: okafor
lines.text: Tower is ours! I can see all the way to the river.

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: Elevated position lost. Reclaiming.

lines.speaker: okafor
lines.text: Heavy armor, coming up the slope!

lines.speaker: thule
lines.text: The valley is ours. Good work, all of you.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Brann and his Ironmongers have been robbing every camp on the road. Last night they burned the Kettle family out of the mill and took their children for workers.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Kettle is still fighting at the east end of the ruins. Join up with him. Alt+click the map to call for help or to point him at a target, and he will answer.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Brann fights like we do, with the same guns and the same tricks. Burn his base to the ground.

lines.speaker: brann
lines.text: Thule! Heard about you. Join me, or get out of my valley.

lines.speaker: thule
lines.text: Neither. Everyone, on Kettle. Hit them together.

lines.speaker: brann
lines.text: You think you are better than me? Out here, nobody is better.

lines.speaker: okafor
lines.text: Ironmongers are breaking. Push!

lines.speaker: brann
lines.text: Fine! Fine. You win. Remember who let you live.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Halcyon owns the sky. Its gunships find our convoys wherever they go. Mags dug two Hornets out of a crop-duster hangar.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Get an Airstrip up, and Flak Nests around the base. Power is short. If the lights flicker, switch something off until the Dynamos catch up.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Then fly over to their hangars and burn them.

lines.speaker: okafor
lines.text: Gunships! Get under cover!

lines.speaker: mags
lines.text: Power is in the red. Switch off the Garage or the Radio Mast, we will live without them.

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: Air superiority contested. Escalating.

lines.speaker: thule
lines.text: The sky is clear. First time since the signal fell.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: East of the hills the ground turns to glass and the crystals sing at night. Halcyon is strip-mining them, and something out there is fighting back.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: We need that Echo. Knock out Halcyon's intakes and hold the singing stone in the middle of the field for two minutes.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Whatever the crystal folk are, they are not our enemy unless we make them one. Try not to.

lines.speaker: choir
lines.text: Iron ones. You are loud. Be quiet, or be still.

lines.speaker: thule
lines.text: We are not here for you. Leave us be, and we leave you be.

lines.speaker: okafor
lines.text: Machines and crystals going at each other. Let them.

lines.speaker: thule
lines.text: Their intakes are dark. Now the stone.

lines.speaker: choir
lines.text: The stone sings for you. For now.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Halcyon is charging a Purge array on the far side of these ruins. When it is full it burns everything inside its circle, and its circle is us.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Mags has plans for a Long Tom: a gun big enough to hit back from here. Build a Foundry, then the gun. Everyone can see a charging superweapon, theirs and ours.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: When the warning comes, scatter. Then bring that array down.

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: Purge array charging. Target: unregistered settlement.

lines.speaker: mags
lines.text: Long Tom is up! Give her five minutes to warm up.

lines.speaker: okafor
lines.text: Strike incoming! Get out of the circle, everyone move!

lines.speaker: thule
lines.text: Their array is down. Now the rest of it.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: A year ago I walked out of Marrow with eight soldiers. Today I am going back with an army.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Halcyon's core sits in the old city center, and everything it has is waiting for us. The crystal host has come down from the glass fields, and it answers to nobody.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Brann is with us, for what that is worth. Bring everything. Destroy the core. Then we can all go home.

lines.speaker: brann
lines.text: Do not get used to this, Thule. I am here for the loot.

lines.speaker: halcyon
lines.text: Marrow is a closed system. You are not permitted.

lines.speaker: okafor
lines.text: Purge charging in the city center. Spread out!

lines.speaker: choir
lines.text: The song is too loud here. We will silence all of it.

lines.speaker: thule
lines.text: All units, everything you have. Now!

lines.speaker: thule
lines.text: The lights are coming back on in Marrow. Ours, this time.

brief.speaker: holdout
brief.text: The array is dark. For the first time in years the screens in the city show nothing at all, and nobody misses them.

brief.speaker: holdout
brief.text: The fields still sing. The Cantor says the song is quieter now, but it is theirs again. WREN sits with them most nights, listening.

brief.speaker: holdout
brief.text: We lost good people getting here. Tomorrow we start rebuilding. Not the way it was. Better, and together.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: The core is quiet. People are coming back to Marrow street by street, carrying whatever they kept.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: Mags has the trams running again, on diesel and stubbornness. Brann took his loot and went back to his valley. The crystals sing on the edge of town, and nobody bothers them.

brief.speaker: thule
brief.text: I said I would bring them home. It took a year and too many good people. But we came the long way back.
